duration_seconds.definition: Elapsed musical annotation coverage, excluding leading padding.

bars.definition: Number of unfolded musical bars, including all planned chorus/repeat occurrences.

beats_per_bar.definition: Quarter-note beats per bar from catalog meter.

catalog_bpm.definition: Catalog nominal quarter-note BPM supplied for initialization.

pitched_instruments.definition: Number of locally available pitched instrument streams; excludes drums.

reference_bar_bpm_median.definition: Median bar-equivalent BPM: 60 times catalog quarter beats per bar divided by annotated bar seconds. Evaluation-only.

reference_bar_bpm_cv.definition: Population SD/mean of bar-equivalent BPM; sensitive to pickups, endings and interpolation. Evaluation-only.

reference_catalog_bpm_abs_fraction.definition: Absolute fractional difference between reference median bar-equivalent BPM and catalog BPM. Evaluation-only.

reference_catalog_bpm_signed_fraction.definition: Signed fractional difference: reference median bar-equivalent BPM/catalog BPM minus one. Evaluation-only.

reference_final_clock_mismatch_beats.definition: Absolute difference between total score beats and duration times catalog BPM/60. Directly related to clock drift; evaluation-only.

triad_vocabulary.definition: Number of distinct pitched reduced chart labels.

triad_chord_entropy_bits.definition: Shannon entropy of chord labels weighted by musical beats in the unfolded plan.

triad_largest_chord_beat_share.definition: Largest chord-class share of pitched musical score beats.

triad_changes_per_minute.definition: Actual changes between successive reduced pitched labels per minute of reference duration; adjacent identical labels merged.

triad_repeated_1gram_fraction.definition: Fraction of start positions whose exact 1-event chord-label sequence appears elsewhere in the unfolded plan; adjacent identical labels merged, N.C. retained.

triad_repeated_2gram_fraction.definition: Fraction of start positions whose exact 2-event chord-label sequence appears elsewhere in the unfolded plan; adjacent identical labels merged, N.C. retained.

triad_repeated_4gram_fraction.definition: Fraction of start positions whose exact 4-event chord-label sequence appears elsewhere in the unfolded plan; adjacent identical labels merged, N.C. retained.

triad_repeated_8gram_fraction.definition: Fraction of start positions whose exact 8-event chord-label sequence appears elsewhere in the unfolded plan; adjacent identical labels merged, N.C. retained.

triad_unique_bar_fraction.definition: Distinct exact within-bar reduced harmonic patterns divided by unfolded bars; includes chord durations, merging adjacent identical reduced labels.

triad_repeated_4bar_fraction.definition: Fraction of four-bar start positions whose complete timed-in-score harmonic pattern occurs elsewhere.

seventh_vocabulary.definition: Number of distinct pitched reduced chart labels.

seventh_chord_entropy_bits.definition: Shannon entropy of chord labels weighted by musical beats in the unfolded plan.

seventh_largest_chord_beat_share.definition: Largest chord-class share of pitched musical score beats.

seventh_changes_per_minute.definition: Actual changes between successive reduced pitched labels per minute of reference duration; adjacent identical labels merged.

seventh_repeated_1gram_fraction.definition: Fraction of start positions whose exact 1-event chord-label sequence appears elsewhere in the unfolded plan; adjacent identical labels merged, N.C. retained.

seventh_repeated_2gram_fraction.definition: Fraction of start positions whose exact 2-event chord-label sequence appears elsewhere in the unfolded plan; adjacent identical labels merged, N.C. retained.

seventh_repeated_4gram_fraction.definition: Fraction of start positions whose exact 4-event chord-label sequence appears elsewhere in the unfolded plan; adjacent identical labels merged, N.C. retained.

seventh_repeated_8gram_fraction.definition: Fraction of start positions whose exact 8-event chord-label sequence appears elsewhere in the unfolded plan; adjacent identical labels merged, N.C. retained.

seventh_unique_bar_fraction.definition: Distinct exact within-bar reduced harmonic patterns divided by unfolded bars; includes chord durations, merging adjacent identical reduced labels.

seventh_repeated_4bar_fraction.definition: Fraction of four-bar start positions whose complete timed-in-score harmonic pattern occurs elsewhere.

quality_flagged_pitched_files.definition: Number of fixed-audit flagged pitched files: polyphony>4, any note>10s, or outside88keys; no filtering.

pooled_note_count.definition: Number of note-on events during musical annotation coverage; simultaneous notes count separately.

pooled_onsets_per_second.definition: Note-on count during musical annotation coverage divided by its elapsed seconds; simultaneous notes count separately.

pooled_active_coverage.definition: Fraction of 200-ms grid instants with at least one sounding note, preserving instrument multiplicity.

pooled_onset_coverage_1s.definition: Fraction of grid instants with a note-on in the causal trailing one-second window.

pooled_maximum_polyphony.definition: Maximum overlapping note instances during musical annotation coverage; separate instruments/unisons count separately.

pooled_median_note_seconds.definition: Median complete exported duration of notes starting inside musical annotation coverage; diagnostic only.

pooled_p95_note_seconds.definition: 95th percentile exported duration of those notes; diagnostic only.

pooled_note_fraction_over_10s.definition: Fraction of those notes with exported duration exceeding ten seconds; diagnostic only.

bass_note_count.definition: Number of note-on events during musical annotation coverage; simultaneous notes count separately.

bass_onsets_per_second.definition: Note-on count during musical annotation coverage divided by its elapsed seconds; simultaneous notes count separately.

bass_active_coverage.definition: Fraction of 200-ms grid instants with at least one sounding note, preserving instrument multiplicity.

bass_onset_coverage_1s.definition: Fraction of grid instants with a note-on in the causal trailing one-second window.

bass_maximum_polyphony.definition: Maximum overlapping note instances during musical annotation coverage; separate instruments/unisons count separately.

bass_median_note_seconds.definition: Median complete exported duration of notes starting inside musical annotation coverage; diagnostic only.

bass_p95_note_seconds.definition: 95th percentile exported duration of those notes; diagnostic only.

bass_note_fraction_over_10s.definition: Fraction of those notes with exported duration exceeding ten seconds; diagnostic only.

bass_reference_harmony_onset_count.definition: Number of positive-duration MIDI note-ons inside musical coverage with an active pitched reference chord. Each simultaneous note counts separately; N.C./annotation gaps excluded.

bass_reference_harmony_excluded_onset_co.definition: Note-ons inside musical coverage excluded because the timestamp is N.C. or lacks a pitched chord annotation.

bass_reference_root_onset_fraction.definition: Fraction of eligible note-ons whose pitch class equals the annotated chord root at onset. Exact half-open timestamp intervals; N.C./gaps excluded; slash bass ignored. All exported pitches count, including outside88keys. Evaluation-only.

bass_reference_base_tone_onset_fraction.definition: Fraction of eligible note-ons inside the annotated base chord template (major/minor/diminished/augmented/sus2/sus4/power/root as canonicalized). Sevenths, extensions, alterations and slash bass ignored. Same event denominator as root fraction. Evaluation-only.

bass_reference_harmony_active_frames.definition: Number of 200-ms grid instants with a pitched reference chord and at least one active note in this role. N.C./gaps and silence excluded.

bass_reference_root_active_fraction.definition: Fraction of eligible active-role frames containing at least one note at the annotated root pitch class. Denominator excludes silence, N.C. and gaps; all exported pitches count. Note state uses onset<=time<offset. Evaluation-only.

horns_note_count.definition: Number of note-on events during musical annotation coverage; simultaneous notes count separately.

horns_onsets_per_second.definition: Note-on count during musical annotation coverage divided by its elapsed seconds; simultaneous notes count separately.

horns_active_coverage.definition: Fraction of 200-ms grid instants with at least one sounding note, preserving instrument multiplicity.

horns_onset_coverage_1s.definition: Fraction of grid instants with a note-on in the causal trailing one-second window.

horns_maximum_polyphony.definition: Maximum overlapping note instances during musical annotation coverage; separate instruments/unisons count separately.

horns_median_note_seconds.definition: Median complete exported duration of notes starting inside musical annotation coverage; diagnostic only.

horns_p95_note_seconds.definition: 95th percentile exported duration of those notes; diagnostic only.

horns_note_fraction_over_10s.definition: Fraction of those notes with exported duration exceeding ten seconds; diagnostic only.

horns_reference_harmony_onset_count.definition: Number of positive-duration MIDI note-ons inside musical coverage with an active pitched reference chord. Each simultaneous note counts separately; N.C./annotation gaps excluded.

horns_reference_harmony_excluded_onset_c.definition: Note-ons inside musical coverage excluded because the timestamp is N.C. or lacks a pitched chord annotation.

horns_reference_root_onset_fraction.definition: Fraction of eligible note-ons whose pitch class equals the annotated chord root at onset. Exact half-open timestamp intervals; N.C./gaps excluded; slash bass ignored. All exported pitches count, including outside88keys. Evaluation-only.

horns_reference_base_tone_onset_fraction.definition: Fraction of eligible note-ons inside the annotated base chord template (major/minor/diminished/augmented/sus2/sus4/power/root as canonicalized). Sevenths, extensions, alterations and slash bass ignored. Same event denominator as root fraction. Evaluation-only.

horns_reference_harmony_active_frames.definition: Number of 200-ms grid instants with a pitched reference chord and at least one active note in this role. N.C./gaps and silence excluded.

horns_reference_root_active_fraction.definition: Fraction of eligible active-role frames containing at least one note at the annotated root pitch class. Denominator excludes silence, N.C. and gaps; all exported pitches count. Note state uses onset<=time<offset. Evaluation-only.
